review_text: 1. Food was good but not the best. I like that their offerings are not your standard coffee shop flair. Just questioning why they decided go turn the monsieur sandwich into a beignet by covering it with heaps of powdered sugar. Pricing is a bit on the expensive side. Expect to spend about 200-250 per person. Drinks were meh. 2. Service was not bad. We were the only customers and waitress was very kind and attentive. They informed us, before ordering, what was no available. 3. Place is small. Which is not bad. But they fall prey to the "aesthetics first, think about the customers later" plague. They offer plated food and pasta but their tables are way too low to be able to eat comfortably.
Pasta was rly tasty. Garlic bread could have been better. Server was really nice. Place was quaint and cozy. It was a good find

Today, we drove all the way to checkout this place. It was recommended by a friend. I was quite disappointed because I wanted to order a rice meal. But the only once they had was Chicken based meals. And unfortunately, I'm allergic to it. So, we ordered their alredo linguine tuna 4.5/5. Serving was quite tiny. And Beef pasta ( I forgot the name) 3/5. I did not like it that much. Cost was 200php/serving. Maybe I should have ordered something else... Coffee was okay.. 4/5 Caramel cheesecake.. 4/5 (kinda a bit too sweet for me. A must to order coffee with it. Or else ma-umay Ka SA Ka tam-is) The place was a bit small. Overall experience 4/5.. Will I dine once again?! Yes! Most especially if I'm in the area .
